skills.skill: Expand a number given in scientific notation into standard form

misconceptions.pattern: Shifts the decimal point the wrong number of places when expanding (answers 3.2 × 10^3 as 320 or 32000 instead of 3200), mis-counting against the exponent.

strategies.intent: The exponent tells you how many places to move the decimal point to the right: 3.2 × 10^3 moves the point three places to make 3200. Add zeros as needed to fill the places.
